explanation: Jenga is a form of the Swahili verb meaning to build. Its British creator, Leslie Scott, grew up partly in Africa and launched the game in London in 1983.

claims.text: The name Jenga comes from Swahili, in which jenga is a form of the verb meaning to build.
The name Jenga does not come from Japanese, Zulu or Hindi.
Jenga was created by the British game designer Leslie Scott, who spent part of her childhood in Africa.
Jenga was launched in London in 1983.
